rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for a tooth in a mouth, including a human or animal tooth.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 ngaa4 zung6 tung3 gan2

rows.note: Use this for a sharp projection on a saw blade rather than a mouth tooth or a gear tooth.

example.english: Every tooth on this saw is very sharp.
example.traditional: 呢把鋸每粒鋸齒都好利。
example.jyutping: ni1 baa2 geoi3 mui5 lap1 geoi3 ci2 dou1 hou2 lei6

rows.note: Use this technical term for a tooth on a gear or cog that engages another gear or a chain.

example.english: This gear has one chipped tooth.
example.traditional: 呢個齒輪有一粒輪齒崩咗。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ci2 leon4 jau5 jat1 lap1 leon4 ci2 bang1 zo2
